root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: The live DPRINTF read of `inp[i].pi_str.s_buf` is bounded by `l` bytes.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: At the SummaryInformation string debug print, the bytes consumed from `inp[i].pi_str.s_buf` must not exceed the declared property length `l`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable source reaches the live `DPRINTF` call with `s=%s`, so the print ignores `l` and treats `inp[i].pi_str.s_buf` as an unbounded C string. The fixed source changes the same sink to `%.*s` with `(int)l`, making the read span respect the declared property length.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original reaches `property_debug_sink` with the live print reading past `l` while the protected sink executes. The fixed original reaches the same sink with the read span capped to `l` by `%.*s`.

edges.relation: The raw SummaryInformation payload pointer stored in `inp[i].pi_str.s_buf` is passed unchanged into the subsequent DPRINTF string operand at the crashing sink.
